ws_unja_ac_id.title: ws.unja.ac.id - Web Application Analysis
ws_unja_ac_id.description: Laravel-based web application, accessed via https://ws.unja.ac.id
auth_flow: GET /login - returns login form with CSRF token
POST /login - authenticates with username/password + XSRF-TOKEN header
GET /dashboard - protected route, returns dashboard UI
All requests require valid laravel_session cookie + XSRF-TOKEN header
ws_unja_ac_id.notes: ws.unja.ac.id is a web application, NOT a VPN server. WireGuard VPN setup provided as alternative for remote access.
